name: All 24 proposals send to two mild reactions before any commitment
Reactions withhold scores, effects and acceptance; facilitator questions are optional
Only standing by the proposal charges time and resolves it once
Reconsider, Escape, Undo and refresh preserve the tentative reaction state
Every historical agreement costs correctly and scores once
All 16 alternative proposals resolve through accept, bargain or walkaway
Counteroffer ends forced retries and advances the issue
Roll targets use pre-agreement Stalin; failed roll charges no automatic penalty
Warm relationships make bargaining free; hostile relations still clamp
Each leader at 1 blocks UN without cost; toast to 2 unlocks it
Walkaway closes issue, preserves other priorities and does not fabricate completion
Deliberate deferral is confirmed, free and reversible
Exhaustion and zero-day complications retain the final choice
No scores or reasons exposed in live outcome or log; ending reveals the ledger
Undo restores exact state after send, roll, settlement and restart
Keyboard-only full game, historical reveal and printed debrief
Adverse playthrough: alternative, failed roll, Stalin 1, UN lock and last-day toast
All screens fit 375, 1280 and 1920px with notes on/off
Animated die resolves, and Undo cancels its pending callback
Save and refresh round-trip; original-version save is preserved
Storage denial and corrupt saves do not prevent play
Stylised portraits and issue artwork are self-contained; previews reveal no evaluative pose
Portrait motion respects reduced-motion preference
Room persists through choosing and sending; reaction bubbles sit with their speakers
Desktop HUD sits beside the room and narrow layout stacks without overlap
Facilitator hidden by default; no runtime errors or external requests
